name: Bank Transaction-booking_date
label: Booking Date
description: The day the bank booked the line. Date keeps each source's own date (bexio: value date).

name: Bank Transaction-value_date
label: Value Date
description: The day the line's funds moved (bank value date). Equal to Booking Date for Wise and PayPal, which give one date.

name: Bank Transaction-end_to_end_id
label: End to End Id
description: The payment's EndToEndId from a camt file (the payment run's reference). Bank Matching finds the Payment Entry by it first.
